description:
Convert the Gradle build scripts of the 'WeatherApp' project from Groovy DSL (.gradle) to Kotlin DSL (.gradle.kts).

The project currently uses:
- settings.gradle
- build.gradle (root)
- app/build.gradle

You must:
1. Convert 'settings.gradle' to 'settings.gradle.kts' (update pluginManagement, dependencyResolutionManagement, rootProject.name, and include).
2. Convert root 'build.gradle' to 'build.gradle.kts' (update plugins block).
3. Convert 'app/build.gradle' to 'app/build.gradle.kts' (update plugins, android block, dependencies).
4. Remove the old .gradle files.
5. Verify the project builds successfully after conversion.

Key syntax changes to apply:
- Use double quotes "string" instead of single quotes.
- Use function calls: implementation("...") instead of implementation '...'
- Use assignment for properties: compileSdk = 34 instead of compileSdk 34
- Use id("...") in plugin blocks.

The project must build successfully with './gradlew assembleDebug' to pass.
